quality.reference_precision_criterion: split_reference_rmse <= 0.25 * min(mean candidate RMSE at 256 spp for counter, mean candidate RMSE at 256 spp for halton)
quality.reference_retry_policy: exactly once, same four seeds, failed scenes only

scheduling.note: fixed for quality and timing; gallery comparison members record explicit per-render overrides

motion_cost.note: the authored scene designs are identical after excluding only Camera.FILE and Camera.SHUTTER; renderer geometry fingerprints may still differ because shutter is intentionally part of parsed scene identity

timing.summary_statistic: median with minimum and maximum of exactly three measured repeats
